title: Roof replacement
intro: Here are three ways to do your new roof, all installed by our own crew with the old roof torn off and hauled away.

options.name: Good
options.headline: Architectural shingles
options.warranty: Manufacturer's limited lifetime shingle warranty, 5 years on our workmanship.
points: Synthetic underlayment over the whole roof
New drip edge, starter strip and ridge cap

options.name: Better
options.headline: Upgraded shingle system
options.warranty: Manufacturer's enhanced system warranty, 10 years on our workmanship.
points: Peel-and-stick secondary water barrier (helps with Florida insurance)
Ice-and-water shield in valleys and at every wall
Ridge vent for better attic airflow

options.name: Best
options.headline: Standing seam metal
options.warranty: Manufacturer's 40-year paint finish warranty, 15 years on our workmanship.
points: Hidden fasteners, built for high-wind zones
Lasts two to three times as long as shingles

allowances.note: We'll show you any rotten wood before replacing it.

notes: Work usually takes one to two days once materials arrive.
terms: 30% deposit to get on the schedule, the rest when the job passes final inspection.
